# WebCare Pro - AI Readiness & GEO Optimization Auditor
> Enterprise Automated Engine for Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), AI Search Crawlers, and Agentic Interoperability.

## Overview
WebCare Pro AI Readiness & Technical Audit Tool (https://webcarespro.com/ai-audit) evaluates websites against 44 automated technical checks across:
1. **AI Search & LLM Discovery**: Crawl policies for GPTBot, ClaudeBot, Google-Extended, PerplexityBot, llms.txt discovery, robots.txt directives.
2. **Generative Engine Optimization (GEO)**: JSON-LD Graph integrity, Entity disambiguation, Wikidata citations, Article/Author schemas, FAQ/HowTo structured data.
3. **Agentic Web Standards & Tool Calling**: Model Context Protocol (MCP) server endpoints, OpenAPI / swagger specs, WebMCP micro-actions, agent rate-limiting headers.
4. **Content Extraction & LLM Parsing**: Markdown alternate links, HTML semantic density, article text-to-code ratios, clean main-content layout without DOM trapping.
5. **Technical Speed & Server Hygiene**: Core Web Vitals (LCP, INP, CLS), TTFB, HTTPS/TLS v1.3 configuration, SSRF-safe bot processing.

## Documentation & Fix Guides
Full remediation guides with code snippets and Schema templates are available at:
